beta.title: Beta programme
beta.intro: Get new features first and help shape them. Everything here stays on this device until you click a button that opens GitHub.
beta.join: Join the beta on this device
beta.notJoined: You are not in the beta on this device.
beta.what: Joining turns on the features in beta here and, in the desktop app, switches updates to the beta channel. Leaving undoes both.
beta.joined.toast: You joined the beta. Thank you!
beta.left.toast: You left the beta. Updates follow stable releases again.
beta.weekly: Once a week, prepare a usage report I can send
beta.weekly.hint: Counts only: days used, starts, errors and the app's command names. No notes, names or ids. You see all of it before anything leaves.
beta.preview: This week's report, exactly as it would be sent:
beta.opened: The issue form is open in a new tab. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.
beta.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
beta.feedback.title: Short title
beta.feedback.text: What happened, or what you would like
beta.feedback.env: Include the app version, platform and language
beta.feedback.tooLong: The text is too long for a link. It was copied: paste it into the issue.
beta.kind.question: A question
beta.reminder: Your weekly beta report is ready
beta.reminder.body: Counts only. You review it before anything is sent.
